scale_transform: none; 1000-unit em rendered directly into SVG user units and framed by the viewBox
geometry_adjustments: none; only a non-rendering viewBox margin was added to prevent edge clipping

generation_toolchain.interface: Python standard-library ctypes; no downloaded Python packages
generation_toolchain.shaping: HarfBuzz hb_shape with guessed segment properties and default OpenType features

limitations: This is a first stable outline candidate and has not received human visual approval.
Spacing is the source font's default HarfBuzz-shaped spacing; no optical adjustment pass was performed.
The viewBox includes a small non-rendering safety margin and is not a production export specification.
The candidate contains only wordmark glyph outlines and no symbol geometry or background.
review_checklist: Confirm the exact ARTales letterforms and uppercase/lowercase balance.
Review literary character, softness, readability, and distinctiveness.
Review kerning and spacing, especially AR, RT, Ta, al, le, and es.
Inspect outline smoothness and behavior at intended sizes.
Decide whether an adjustment pass is needed before any master-lock proposal.
finalization_requirements: Complete any separately reviewed spacing or width adjustment pass.
Create a separate wordmark master-lock pull request; do not promote this candidate in place.
Consider lockup work only after a wordmark master exists.
next_steps: Conduct human visual review of this outline candidate.
Either request a controlled adjustment pass or approve the geometry direction.
If approved, prepare a separate wordmark master-lock pull request.
